label: Dell Latitude — No POST / Black Screen
description: User reports laptop will not boot. Powered on this morning, saw Dell logo then black screen. No POST beeps. Tried holding power button 30s, no change. AC adapter light is on. User has not tried anything else.

label: Intune Enrollment Stuck — New Hire Laptop
description: New hire's laptop has been stuck at 'Setting up your device for work' during Autopilot for 40+ minutes. User has restarted twice with no change. Device shows connected to corporate Wi-Fi. Manager is asking for ETA since employee starts training in an hour.

label: VPN Client Fails to Connect — Remote User
description: User working from home cannot connect to corporate VPN since this morning. Client shows 'Error 809 — network connection between your computer and VPN server could not be established.' Home internet is confirmed working (able to browse). User has not changed any settings recently.

label: SCCM Application Deployment Failing Fleet-Wide
description: Mandatory security patch deployment via SCCM is failing across ~40 devices in the Chicago office with error code 0x87D00607 (content download failure). Deployment deadline is EOD per compliance requirement. Devices are otherwise online and checking in normally.

label: VMware Host Showing Degraded Performance
description: vCenter alert triggered for esxi-host-07: CPU ready time elevated above threshold for 15+ minutes, 3 VMs showing degraded responsiveness including a production database VM. No recent vMotion or DRS events logged. Host is not in maintenance mode.

label: Cloud Storage Sync Failure — Finance Shared Drive
description: Shared drive sync client has been showing 'Sync paused — quota exceeded' since yesterday for the Finance team shared folder. Multiple users on the same shared drive report the same error. Files edited locally are not appearing for teammates. Quarter-end close is in progress.

label: Password Reset Loop — MFA Not Prompting
description: User reset their password after expiration but is stuck in a login loop — enters new password, gets returned to login screen with no error, and is never prompted for MFA. Tried on both desktop app and browser. Account is not locked per admin console.

label: Plant Floor Workstation Offline — Production Line 3
description: Workstation controlling Line 3 scanning/labeling station went unresponsive mid-shift. Screen is black, workstation does not respond to keyboard/mouse. Line has been manually halted per supervisor. Physical power light is on but no display output. This is a production-blocking incident.
